2607.07314.title: FedCVESA: Taking Away Training Data in Federated Learning via Correlation Value Encoding and Segmented Aggregation
2607.07314.paper_summary: Federated learning (FL) avoids explicit data exposure by keeping raw data on local clients, yet privacy risks remain in the training process and the learned model itself. Recently, centralized Taking Away Training Data (TATD) attacks have shown that malicious training could abuse the memorization capacity of deep models to store and later recover training data. However, this memorization-based threat has not been systematically studied under FL environments, where multi-client averaging could overwrite encoded training data. In this paper, we study a white-box TATD attack in which a malicious server selects n target clients from K participating clients and actively writes private training data into the global model during federated training. We propose FedCVESA, a federated variant of Correlation Value Encoding Attack (CVEA), by adding a Pearson-correlation regularizer to the loss function of target clients, so that private training data are gradually encoded into selected model parameters, referred to as carrier parameters. To reduce the overwriting of carrier parameters during server aggregation, we further propose segmented aggregation over dispersed carrier parameters, preserving selected carrier parameters while keeping standard averaging on the remaining parameters. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet non-IID partitions show that the proposed method can steal semantically meaningful private training images from the trained model while maintaining acceptable main-task utility in a controlled proof-of-concept setting. These results demonstrate that FL can become a parameter-level memorization channel for active TATD attack under the studied white-box malicious-server setting.
2607.07314.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習（FL）透過將原始數據保留在本地客戶端來避免明確的數據暴露，但在訓練過程和學習到的模型本身仍然存在隱私風險。最近，集中式的取走訓練數據（TATD）攻擊顯示，惡意訓練可能利用深度模型的記憶能力來存儲並隨後恢復訓練數據。然而，這種基於記憶的威脅在FL環境下尚未得到系統性研究，因為多客戶端平均可能會覆蓋編碼的訓練數據。在本文中，我們研究了一種白盒TATD攻擊，其中惡意伺服器從K個參與客戶端中選擇n個目標客戶端，並在聯邦訓練過程中主動將私有訓練數據寫入全局模型。我們提出了FedCVESA，一種聯邦變體的相關值編碼攻擊（CVEA），通過在目標客戶端的損失函數中添加皮爾森相關正則化項，使得私有訓練數據逐漸編碼到選定的模型參數中，稱為承載參數。為了減少伺服器聚合過程中對承載參數的覆蓋，我們進一步提出了對分散承載參數的分段聚合，保留選定的承載參數，同時對其餘參數進行標準平均。在Dirichlet非IID劃分下對MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10的實驗表明，所提出的方法可以從訓練模型中竊取語義上有意義的私有訓練圖像，同時在受控的概念驗證設置中保持可接受的主要任務效用。這些結果表明，在所研究的白盒惡意伺服器設置下，FL可以成為主動TATD攻擊的參數級記憶通道。
